title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Med Student. Tip #1
body: She got through MDCAT and the entire family has not stopped mentioning it. Ask which year. First year is anatomy and quiet panic. Third year is a confidence that is not yet earned. Final year is a person who has stopped explaining anything to anybody. It's a sealed deal if she can name the exact teacher who failed her and the exact date.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 MDCAT survivors, I see you.

#islamabad #pakistan #mdcat #medstudent #doctor #shifa #medical #relatable

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Med Student. Tip #2
body: Ask what comes after and watch the map appear. FCPS here, USMLE if the family can fund it, PLAB if the plan is the UK, and half of Islamabad medicine is quietly preparing for one of those without telling their parents how seriously. It's a sealed deal if she knows this year's exam date without checking.
caption:
Tip #2 😭 MDCAT survivors, I see you.

#islamabad #pakistan #mdcat #medstudent #doctor #shifa #medical #relatable

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Med Student. Tip #3
body: Watch the money conversation, because it's the wound. Five years, then house job, then a salary that a batchmate in a software house cleared in month two. Everyone knows. Nobody says it in front of the parents. Mention dentistry and watch her face. It's a sealed deal if she has a cousin in IT and they no longer compare.
caption:
Tip #3 😭 MDCAT survivors, I see you.

#islamabad #pakistan #mdcat #medstudent #doctor #shifa #medical #relatable

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Med Student. Tip #4
body: Ask where she wants to end up. Shifa, Kulsum, Maroof, that's the private tier and everyone names one. The government hospital is where she is actually working right now, on nights, for almost nothing, learning more than she will admit. Both are true at once. It's a sealed deal if she can describe a shift that broke her in a completely flat voice.
caption:
Tip #4 😭 MDCAT survivors, I see you.

#islamabad #pakistan #mdcat #medstudent #doctor #shifa #medical #relatable

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Med Student. Tip #5
body: Look at the phone. Four thousand photos of whiteboards, slides, and other people's notes, none organised, all essential. There is a batch group that has been running for five years and is the only reason anyone graduates. It's a sealed deal if she has lost a photo she took specifically so she would not lose it.
caption:
Tip #5 😭 MDCAT survivors, I see you.

#islamabad #pakistan #mdcat #medstudent #doctor #shifa #medical #relatable

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Med Student. Tip #6
body: Ask about the relatives. A doctor in a Pakistani family is a permanent status object, and she has been the answer to somebody's question since she was seventeen. Every wedding, someone shows her a rash. She always looks. It's a sealed deal if a relative has described symptoms over the phone and then ignored every word of the advice.
caption:
Tip #6 😭 MDCAT survivors, I see you.

#islamabad #pakistan #mdcat #medstudent #doctor #shifa #medical #relatable

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Med Student. Tip #7
body: Watch what she does with a rare free evening. Not somewhere expensive, not on that stipend. A chai place near the hospital, one cup, three hours, with the same four people who have seen her at her worst. These are not friendships, they are a shared trauma with a WhatsApp group. It's a sealed deal if she'd take a call from any of them at 4am without checking who it was.
caption:
Tip #7 😭 MDCAT survivors, I see you.
